description: MCP diff/redline tools: document_editor_diff_versions compares two saved versions (or a version vs. the current state) into a structured agent-friendly diff (summary counters, added/removed/changed blocks with word-level diff segments, redlineAvailable flag) via DocumentComparisonService; document_editor_export_redline exports the comparison as a DOCX with real w:ins/w:del tracked changes (DocumentRedlineDocxExporter) or a PDF rendered with review markup through the headless pipeline. Identical versions yield an empty diff and refuse redline export.
